title: Snotgreen
html_source:
Mucus appears quite a bit in Ulysses: In “Telemachus”, both the sea and Stephen’s tissue were described as “snotgreen”, and at the end of this chapter, Joyce spends quite a long time describing Stephen picking his nose.

Also refers to the sea in Dublin Bay which he describes as ‘The snotgreen sea. The scrotum tightening sea.’ in Telemachus/Chapter 1.
